description: Maps Overture Maps place categories onto our industry ids. Read by both scripts/fetch-overture.py (extraction) and packages/core (import), so the two can never disagree about what a barber is. Overture's taxonomy is finer than ours in places and coarser in others; every decision below is a judgement call and is meant to be argued with.

notes.beauty_salon: Overture's largest beauty category and deliberately vague — it covers shops that would call themselves a hair salon, a nail bar, or both. Given its own industry rather than folded into hair-salons, because guessing would quietly corrupt the per-industry numbers you make decisions from. Merge it later if the calls tell you it is really hair.
notes.medical_spa: Excluded. A med-aesthetics clinic with injectables is a different business, a different buyer and a different regulatory world from a day spa. Add it deliberately if you decide to sell there.
notes.tanning_salon: Excluded for now — appointment-based, so arguably a fit, but a different enough trade that it deserves your call rather than mine.
notes.hair_supply_stores: Excluded. Retail, not a service business taking bookings.
